characters.name: SIIL SASSI
characters.description: Väike pruun siil, kelle selg ja pealagi on kaetud paljude teravate okastega, terav ninake, väikesed ümarad kõrvad, ilma koheva sabata. Seljas roheline kootud kampsun, suured mustad silmad ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: JÄNES JUKU
characters.description: Väike valge jänes pikkade kõrvadega, seljas kollased püksid, uudishimulik ja rõõmus näoilme. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Töökoda hoovis
locations.description: Cozy wooden workshop with light brown wood walls, a sturdy wooden workbench in the center, small hand tools neatly hung on a wall rack, a single window on the back wall showing bright autumn trees outside with yellow and orange leaves, soft warm daylight from the window. Simple craft room setting in cartoon style.

locations.name: Sügisene aed puu all
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with green grass, scattered colorful autumn leaves on the ground, and a large oak tree on the right side. Bright autumn daylight, cozy warm outdoor setting in cartoon style.

Bright warm daylight.
